g.text: Cross-engine expression proxy (percentile-normalised max of LIANA lr_means & CellChat probability; covers 1145/1311 candidates). Raising the floor shrinks only the S1 candidate count; S2–S5 are essentially invariant — the surviving biology is well-expressed and the funnel is not a low-expression artifact.
